script_text: Stop! Pisces, the stars are screaming at you right now. Neptune, your water-sign ruling planet, is retrograde in Aries and forming a tense square to Jupiter in Cancer, activating your 2nd House of Finances and 5th House of Pleasure. This cosmic friction demands you distinguish fantasy from fact. Neptune's retreat forces clarity in your 2nd House before noon. Romantically, singles should attract a stable earth-sign presence as Venus in Virgo blesses your 7th House of Partnerships. Taken Pisces must avoid vague evasions that trigger insecurity with your partner tonight. Career-wise, the Sun in your 5th House of Creative Ventures highlights a proposal that boosts income via your 2nd House resources. Do not sign contracts without reviewing the 2nd House numbers closely. Blessing: an unexpected refund or gift arrives through Mercury's sextile to Pluto in your 12th House of Endings. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
